title: axis 语义：压掉的是哪一维
expected_output:
a =
[[0 1 2]
 [3 4 5]]
sum()           = 15
sum(axis=0)     = [3 5 7] -> 压掉第 0 维（行方向），得到每列的和
sum(axis=1)     = [ 3 12] -> 压掉第 1 维（列方向），得到每行的和
argmax(axis=0)  = [1 1 1] -> 每列最大值所在的行号
argmax(axis=1)  = [2 2] -> 每行最大值所在的列号
--- 三维数组 ---
b.shape              = (2, 3, 4)
b.sum(axis=0).shape  = (3, 4)
b.sum(axis=1).shape  = (2, 4)
b.sum(axis=(0, 2)).shape = (3,)
keepdims 保留维度 :
b.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True).shape = (2, 1, 4)
code:
import numpy as np
a = np.arange(6).reshape(2, 3)
print("a =")
print(a)
print("sum()           =", int(a.sum()))
print("sum(axis=0)     =", a.sum(axis=0), "-> 压掉第 0 维（行方向），得到每列的和")
print("sum(axis=1)     =", a.sum(axis=1), "-> 压掉第 1 维（列方向），得到每行的和")
print("argmax(axis=0)  =", a.argmax(axis=0), "-> 每列最大值所在的行号")
print("argmax(axis=1)  =", a.argmax(axis=1), "-> 每行最大值所在的列号")
b = np.arange(24).reshape(2, 3, 4)
print("--- 三维数组 ---")
print("b.shape              =", b.shape)
print("b.sum(axis=0).shape  =", b.sum(axis=0).shape)
print("b.sum(axis=1).shape  =", b.sum(axis=1).shape)
print("b.sum(axis=(0, 2)).shape =", b.sum(axis=(0, 2)).shape)
print("keepdims 保留维度 :")
print("b.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True).shape =", b.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True).shape)
